english: You've got a slim chance to find better loot. Adds 5% to loot bonus for containers that you open personally. Looting is 56% faster.

english: Adds 15% to loot bonus. Looting is 68% faster.

english: You just seem to be blessed with finding great loot everywhere you look. Adds 20% to loot bonus. Looting is 74% faster.
